doc.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

chapter: Bass playing, avant-garde and the state of the music
title: His influence on younger bassists
summary: Ware has heard players who say they were influenced by him but hears Paul Chambers more in current bassists.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Do you see yourself -- you talked about how Paul has influenced the, you know, the bassists. (inaudible). How do you see yourself as having influenced?

Well, I can't say. I've heard people say they've been influenced by me, a whole lot of them. It's gratifying and I've listened for certain things that I used to do, I can hear in some cats. You know, but like the way bass players are going now, I don't hear it as much, but I hear it in an extension of Paul Chambers, you know, which is beautiful.
